description: Open Action Record test vectors. Every verifier must reach the expected result on every case. TEST KEYS ONLY.

cases.description: A $1,900 refund: held over the approval limit, approved with a passkey, executed with state before and after, confirmed; sealed, checkpointed and timestamped by the test authority. All values disclosed.
refund-lifecycle with the held decision rewritten as "allowed".
refund-lifecycle with the disclosed state after the change edited ($190 refunded instead of $1,900).
refund-lifecycle with the approval record removed.
refund-lifecycle with a retention statement and an unknown bundle field. Both are ignored by verification.
refund-lifecycle after erasure: the disclosures of the state before and after are deleted. The records still verify.
A store credit recorded without a sealing service: issuer-signed only. Nothing disclosed.
The same bundle verified with seals required.
A refund the payment API reported as succeeded but the read-back does not show, and a blocked 80% discount. The records verify; the outcomes are "not_confirmed" and "denied".
OAR approval and outcome evidence added to a receipt in another format (external_ref with the digest of its bytes).

A $48,000 wire held over the limit and approved through an outside service (a SIM check). The approval binding covers the action and what the approver was shown; the proof is recorded by digest. All values disclosed.
An approver signed a rejection with a passkey; the issuer recorded and re-signed it as approved. Only the approval binding check fails.
A payout that relied on two outside artifacts (a delegated authorization and a credential proof), both checked again just before it committed, then confirmed. Outcome class: committed.
The person revoked the delegated authorization between the decision and the payout. The re-check found it, so the payout was refused and nothing ran. Outcome class: refused.
A payout that ran without its authorities being checked again at the moment it committed (the issuer removed the check and re-signed). Only the authority check fails.
The re-check says every authority was current, but the delegated authorization had already expired. Only the authority check fails.
